question: Should CodexBar accept a standalone 1–12 merged-Overview provider-cap preference now, rather than requiring it to arrive with the compact-density behavior described in the related request?
rationale: The branch adds a durable settings surface and chooses its range, while the canonical request says increasing the cap is useful but incomplete without denser rendering.

options.title: Accept the incremental cap control
options.body: Keep the preference opt-in with the existing default of 6, require live proof, and leave compact-density work independently tracked.

options.title: Require a density design first
options.body: Pause this preference until maintainers define how high-cap Overview rows should remain usable without excessive scrolling.

recommendation.title: Accept the incremental cap control
recommendation.body: Keep the preference opt-in with the existing default of 6, require live proof, and leave compact-density work independently tracked.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product-scope choice for the repository’s native UI preferences, not a mechanical code repair.
